notes.title: 0.21 Update Announcement!! Enter the chariot!
notes.notes:
[h2]1. The vehicle system has been launched[/h2]
[h3]At present, there are four vehicles available on the new map for players to drive and collide with zombies, namely a truck and a RV, as well as a sedan and an SUV. If the vehicle overturns, it can be returned to normal by pressing the R key.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/9106bae4932a8180a06d78e8f7ec8ff3e3bf0d42.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/14c6e7282310cd91924426e927bdea8465ebd447.png[/img]
[h2]2. Future plans [/h2]
[h3]Some time in the future I plan to introduce a collection system that can modify the vehicle, unlock the equipment, you can add more cool, lethal equipment to the car, if you have any ideas, please let me know.[/h3]

notes.title: 《Fire Fly》0.16 Update Announcement! Add multiple languages! Partial problem fix!
notes.notes:
[h2] Added Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Russian [/h2]
[h3] You can switch languages through the bottom right corner of the game's main interface [/h3]
[img] {STEAL_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759596/ff2dd00d8961824180eadaca8bae5f1fce7f6da8.png[/img]
[h2] Partial problem fixing [/h2]
[h3] 1. Replaced AK-47 and SCAR-L with more suitable gunshots [/h3]
[h3] 2. Adjusted the third person camera. The original camera received higher feedback from players. In this update, I have moved the camera down as a whole [/h3]
[h3] 3. Adjusted the picking and emitting range of the item [/h3]

notes.title: 《Fire Fly》Update announcement for version 0.14！！！

notes.title: 《Firefly》Have been released！
notes.notes:
Hi! Hello everyone, Firefly is out now on steam! This is a passionate, adrenaline pumping zombie mowing game, with its own story, the game is currently in early access, I will do my best to complete this game in the future, to collect opinions, increase the gameplay, and make sure not to disappoint every single one of you players.
[h3]About Early Access[/h3]
If you encounter a bug in the game, please do not worry, immediately report to the developer, comment section, forum or email "2574823316@qq.com", I will get back to you as soon as I see it.

If the game is stuck, please go to the Settings to reduce the picture quality and select the parameters suitable for your monitor.

If you can't get into the game or if something goes wrong after you get in, please check the troubleshooting page of the store.

Your feedback and comments are the biggest motivation for me to continue developing this game!

I will try my best to make sure that new patches or content are released every week in the future!

Current version Early Access 0.1
